title: Disabled trial button gives no hint why it does nothing; 21+ gate wording and two separate checkboxes
persona: new visitor on iPhone, landing to trial to first session
device: iPhone 13 profile (Chromium engine; WebKit not installed), 390x844 DSF1 (also 360x740)
steps: Tap 'Start 7-day free trial' (hero) without ticking the checkbox
expected: Tapping a greyed CTA explains what is missing (e.g. 'Confirm you are 21+ to continue'); gate says 21+; one confirmation satisfies the page
actual: Button is <a aria-disabled=true> with no href; tap does nothing, no message. Checkbox label reads 'I am legally allowed to bet where I live.' (no age). Hero and pricing-card checkboxes are independent: ticking one leaves the other CTA disabled. Gate itself works: ticking enables a link to the checkout URL.
